title: Natural Hypertrophy: Who I am & my stats
summary: NH introduces himself while keeping his real name and location private, and gives his stats: 25 years old, 6 ft, 215 lb, 17.5-inch arms, 13-inch forearms, 16-inch calves, 26-inch thighs, 16-inch neck. He says he made the channel to build a community of natural lifters and expose himself to criticism, not for fame or money.

claims.claim: NH keeps his real name and location private; he thinks a community of natural lifters doesn't need to know him by name.
NH's stats: age 25, 6 ft without shoes, 215 lb, 17.5-inch arms, 13-inch forearms, 16-inch calves, 26-inch thighs, 16-inch neck.
He created the channel not for fame, money or attention but to build a community of natural lifters working together to get bigger.
He trains alone and feels a need to teach, and also wants to expose himself to criticism through the channel.
